memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-04-15 09:00 with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for CKD follow-up.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- CKD (stage 3a)
  - Status: Stable, BP 138/86, weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cut‑off for men).
  - Plan: Continue telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD. Review diet: reduce salt, avoid processed foods. 
- Due: HbA1c not applicable (non‑diabetic). Next labs in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.42 mg/dL (0.66‑1.25). eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60 normal). Urine ACR 45 mg/g (<30 normal). Haemoglobin 13.8 g/dL (13.0‑17.0).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Telmisartan 40 mg OD
Dapagliflozin 10 mg OD
Furosemide 20 mg OD
Sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Penicillin – rash and pruritus (mild). Avoid beta‑lactams.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Noticed mild ankle swelling after long shifts at pharmacy; no shortness of breath.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- CKD
  - Status: Mild bilateral pedal edema, BP 142/90, weight 80 kg, waist 94 cm.
  - Plan: Increase furosemide to 40 mg OD, add spironolactone 25 mg OD, continue telmisartan and dapagliflozin. Sodium bicarbonate unchanged. Advise low‑salt diet, elevate legs. 
- Due: Repeat labs in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.48 mg/dL. eGFR 49 mL/min/1.73m2. Urine ACR 62 mg/g. Haemoglobin 13.5 g/dL.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Telmisartan 40 mg OD
Dapagliflozin 10 mg OD
Furosemide 40 mg OD
Spironolactone 25 mg OD
Sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Resting ECG: Normal sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm. No ST‑T changes. No evidence of ischemia.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Dr S. Reddy, Cardiology, Narayana Health, for evaluation of uncontrolled hypertension and edema.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Cardiology opinion: Hypertension likely secondary to CKD. Recommend continue current regimen, consider ACE‑i intolerance trial later. No cardiac ischemia. Return to endocrinology for CKD management.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- CKD
  - Status: Edema resolved, BP 130/82, weight 77 kg, waist 88 cm (<90).
  - Plan: Reduce furosemide to 20 mg OD, stop spironolactone (risk of hyperK). Continue telmisartan, dapagliflozin, sodium bicarbonate. Reinforce low‑salt diet. 
- Due: Labs in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.35 mg/dL. eGFR 55 mL/min/1.73m2. Urine ACR 38 mg/g. Haemoglobin 14.0 g/dL.
